title: Topic 12 旅行 Travel
japanese_text: <ruby>都会<rt>とかい</rt></ruby>に<ruby>出<rt>で</rt></ruby>てきてから、<u>出身地</u>の<ruby>言葉<rt>ことば</rt></ruby>が通じないことがよくあった。<u>方言</u>だと<ruby>思<rt>おも</rt></ruby>っていない<ruby>言葉<rt>ことば</rt></ruby>が、<ruby>実<rt>じつ</rt></ruby>は方言だと<ruby>分<rt>わ</rt></ruby>かった。
english_translation: Since moving to the city, I've often found that people can't always understand words that are used where I'm from. I found out that more words than I thought were actually limited to my own dialect.
